and $0.8405$ for the weight-1 morph-smooth; the ADNI setting of
Table~\ref{tab:adni} ($\sigma=0$) gives $0.7541$ and $0.7771$
$\mathrm{T1}\rightarrow\mathrm{FA}$, against $0.7626$ and $0.7520$ in the table.
Dashed: SSIM of each target against the same target with a different noise draw,
